name: meeple-on-board-one-host-v1
description: R17 with the whole payment landing on ONE chosen host rather than a host per meeple. Identical to overlays/meeple-on-board-v1.overlay.json in every other respect, and it exists for one reason: the per-meeple choice Dean ruled on 05/09/2026 multiplies the build enumerator by roughly hosts^meeples and measured at 25,827 ways to pay for a single building at four seats, against 841 with the box and 130 under the v1 loop. This arm keeps the decision of who to feed and how much, and collapses the factor to the number of hosts. Read the branching numbers first, then check whether the hook and the who-gets-fed spread move at all between the two.
